sources.snippet: This survey aims to fill this gap by providing an in-depth analysis of the developments in video and audio generation across the years, and the latest AI techniques for multimedia generation. The primary objective of this paper is to provide a detailed narrative review of the state-of-the-art techniques for AI-based audio and video generation.
